caption: source record SRC-S58. Static canopy increments at the original settings
note: Main-text link: Section 4.6, static-canopy intervals spanning zero. All four pairs use the same 11,124 national temporal test reports. The added canopy measurement is static 2015 at 3 km for hierarchical regression and 8 km for boosting. Annual and fixed-2015 labels refer to the land-cover setting. Intervals use 2,000 airport resamples of saved predictions, with original settings and scale choices fixed. Change is added-canopy minus base Brier loss, multiplied by 1,000; negative values favor canopy addition. Differences were calculated before rounding. The three-date 13 km target context in target_canopy_context.csv serves a separate descriptive role.
